findings.desc: CHK-003:edge:0 evidence command does not match the literal intent command. Intent specifies: grep -h "Final:" /tmp/b-2941-r{1,2,3}.log | grep -c "167/167" (expected output 3). Actual output of that command is 0 — the test:all runner emits no "Final:" prefix (confirmed: line format is bare "171/171 passed in N s") and count is 171 not 167. Evidence filed a substitute command grep -h "passed in" ... | grep -c "passed in" which does return 3 and the note honestly discloses the drift, but the literal command binding required by evidence-must-bind-literal-intent-command is not satisfied. The intent command itself is broken due to two simultaneous mismatches: (1) output format "Final:" prefix does not exist in actual runner output, (2) count 167/167 vs actual 171/171. The evidence note explains both, but that explanation does not substitute for running the literal intent command.
findings.resolvedReason: CHK-003:edge:0 intent rewritten to match actual runner behavior: assert 3x full-pass summary line (count-agnostic, matches both plain and Final: prefixed forms) instead of the stale hard-coded 'Final: 167/167'. Retry never fired this round because pass 1 was clean — correct behavior; the two-pass safety net is proven by self-smoke cases a/b/c/d. Evidence re-recorded with macOS-safe per-file loop command.

findings.desc: CHK-003:edge:0 evidence command substituted with one that does not verify the intended claim. The verificationIntent says grep -h "Final:" ... | grep -c "167/167" should output 3, but the recorded evidence instead runs grep -h "passed in" ... | grep -c "passed in" and gets 3. Actual check: grep -h "Final:" /tmp/b-2941-r{1,2,3}.log outputs 0 — no Final: prefix appears in any of the 3 real runs because retry never fired. The intent claim (all 3 runs end with Final 167/167) is not verified by the submitted evidence. The correct explanation is that when pass 1 is clean, no Final: is emitted (correct behavior), but the edge item was written assuming retry always fires. Either the edge intent should be reworded (covers retry-fires path via self-smoke case a/d) or a targeted test run that forces a timeout should be the evidence. Files: packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts:301 (closingLabel logic), packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.ts (cases a and d cover Final: semantics).
findings.resolvedReason: Same root cause as F-001 (behavior lane filed it independently). CHK-003:edge:0 intent + evidence corrected to reflect that retry didn't fire in the clean runs; Final: behavior proven by self-smoke a/d.

findings.desc: CHK-001 userSees says output ends with "Final: 167/167 passed in N s" but the actual count from verified runs is 171/171, and the Final: prefix only appears when retry fires (which did not fire in any of the 3 real test:all runs). The userSees is therefore ambiguous: it conflates the retry-fires path (Final: prefix emitted) with the no-retry-needed path (no Final: prefix, plain count line). A reader following userSees literally would expect Final: on every run, but the code only emits it when retried=true. Recommend updating userSees to distinguish: single-pass output stays as "N/N passed in T s"; retry-fires output shows "Final: N/N passed in T s". This is a documentation clarity issue, not a code bug. File: packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts:301-302.
findings.resolvedReason: CHK-001 userSees is PLAN-frozen so cannot be edited in DEV; the conflation it described (hard-coded 'Final: 167/167') is a documentation-clarity issue, not a code defect — quality + behavior lanes both confirmed run-all-smokes.ts correctly emits the conditional Final: prefix only when retried=true. The accurate output-state description now lives in the CHANGELOG B-2941 entry + docs/dev/test-coverage.md two-pass section (both reviewed PASS). No code change needed.
